svg.title: How the gold annotation of US20040236146A1 was built
svg.desc: A left-to-right pipeline of six stages: a scanned PDF with no text layer, vision agents reading the rendered pages, assembly into enriched markdown in production's format, five extraction passes, deterministic post-processing, and four adversarial audits. Below, the discarded OCR branch, the resulting gold set, and the three findings only a vision pass reaches.
